logline: Meeting Father Thomas in an abandoned wing of the manor before dawn, Catherine orchestrates a calculated conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract inside intelligence, sealing their treasonous alliance with intimate assurance.

moments.description: Father Thomas arrives at a derelict wing of the manor to meet Catherine, who chides him for being late.
Father Thomas and Catherine exchange dangerous remarks about their illicit secret meetings before dawn.
moments.key_dialogue: A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well.

moments.description: Catherine lays out her calculating demands, ordering Father Thomas to stall the council hearing and act as her spy.
moments.key_dialogue: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.

moments.description: Father Thomas expresses his deep fear of committing treason against the Duke if their conspiracy is uncovered.
moments.key_dialogue: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

moments.description: Catherine seductively tempts Father Thomas with promises of power and a future as a grateful Duchess.
moments.key_dialogue: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.

moments.description: Father Thomas and Catherine seal their treasonous pact with a handshake and an intimate touch before the screen cuts to black.
moments.key_dialogue: The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet.
